result.detail: notebook/eval/design.json lists four gates. Audit requires no duplicate build keys, dangling endpoints or null keys, holding identifier namespaces and evidence coverage 1.0; pruning requires precision, recall and F1 each at least 0.8 on a balanced 100-good/100-injected set plus a calibration table; qa answers a fixed question set without the explanations document or raw extract; link_prediction ranks held-out target-disease links with static, enriched and pruned feature graphs and no leakage. The pruning gate records that it measures injected-error performance, not biological truth.

subject: EV-26
title: Eval design defines four gates: audit, pruning, qa, link_prediction
